rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: ORAblan
rows.Bloom: White. None / no fragrance. up to 25 petals. Average diameter 12". Large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy. Matte, dark green foliage.

Height: 31" to 39" (80 to 100cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Participated in the 1991 Monza Competition (Source: Website Roseto Niso Fumagalli.)
